output.definition_en: A formal written promise to repair or replace a product if it breaks within a certain time.
output.explanation_ar: وعد كتابي رسمي يقدمه البائع أو الصانع بإصلاح المنتج أو استبداله مجانا إذا ظهر به عيب خلال فترة محددة.

examples.example_text: The new laptop comes with a two-year guarantee against hardware faults.
A university degree offers valuable skills, but it is no guarantee of immediate wealth.
The store refused to refund my purchase because the guarantee had already expired.

output.mnemonic_ar: تذكر كلمة "guard" اي يحمي، فالحرف الاول نفسه والكلمة مثل حارس يحمي حقك ومالك عند الشراء

senses.definition_en: A formal written promise to repair or replace an item if it develops a fault.
senses.definition_ar: وثيقة ضمان تجارية تضمن اصلاح السلعة او استبدالها عند حدوث عطل
senses.usage_note: Often used interchangeably with warranty in everyday consumer contexts.

senses.definition_en: An assurance that an event will definitely happen or a specific condition will be met.
senses.definition_ar: تاكيد او تاكيد قاطع بان امرا معينا سيحدث حتما
senses.usage_note: Frequently occurs in negative contexts such as 'there is no guarantee'.
